title: abs keeps its argument's type; min and max select an argument with its own type
description: abs(-3) is the Integer 3 and abs(-2.5) the Float 2.5; min(2, 2.5) is the Integer 2 and max(2, 2.5) the Float 2.5; of two equal arguments the first is selected, so min(1, 1.0) is the Integer 1 and min(1.0, 1) the Float 1.0.
